critical_boundaries: 1880-like comparison is creator design commentary, not an in-world year or universal steam/electricity ban
Kord haunting origin remains House testimony; no universal light or religious rule
Pelor treatment methods and case severities remain distinct
Kuo-toa reverence does not prove Koh divine or a uniform permanent theology
Glepo exile is his report, not a witnessed village hearing or revisit
Minotaur council chooses aid; ten find final rest as bones, not living resurrection
Spa neutrality and paid stays are not species harmlessness or a constructed Guild base
limits: Partial WORLD review, not full setting/institution certification; twelve other unreconciled section bodies remain for later review. No new audio/original ASR, maps, sheets, rulebook, remote URL or rendered-site review.
